our_interpretation: Read the statement as a conditional ceiling on the commercial generative-AI market, rather than merely a description of January 2025 sales.
The ordinary test for industry size is worldwide annual revenue from generative-AI products and services. The source does not explicitly choose revenue over valuation or economic impact.
Multi-trillion means at least USD 2 trillion in one completed year, not cumulative sales or an annualized run rate.
Commercialization is satisfied by actual paid products offered by OpenAI and Anthropic; profitability is not an additional condition.
The source gives no deadline. 'At this point' expresses confidence when writing, not a future resolution date.
No accounting basis is supplied, so it remains unknown rather than being silently assigned.
criteria.support_condition: A finite sequence of years below USD 2 trillion cannot establish an unlimited market ceiling. Support would require a genuinely conclusive event establishing that the defined market cannot reach the threshold.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the commercialization condition is met, credible records establish at least USD 2 trillion in realized worldwide generative-AI product and service revenue in one completed year, using an agreed, consistent accounting scope.
